messages:
tara: FYI we got a customer report where our mobile sample app created duplicate invoices during an onboarding flow. looks like a 429 + optimistic replay combo. short dump below.

leo: can you paste the tiny repro? curious if it's SDK retry jitter or app-level retry.

tara: minimal trace from mobile logs:
````
2026-03-18T09:02:11Z app: POST /v1/invoices -> 429 rate_limited
2026-03-18T09:02:11Z mobile-sdk: network flaky, queued retry with jitter (optimistic replay enabled)
2026-03-18T09:02:11Z app: user tapped resend (UX allowed duplicate tap)
2026-03-18T09:02:12Z mobile-sdk: replay attempt #1 -> 201 created (no idempotency-key)
2026-03-18T09:02:12Z mobile-sdk: replay attempt #2 (queued) -> 201 created
````
Note: mobile sampleapp shows optimistic replay enabled in starter template and also the button UX triggers a resend.

amanda: ah — two things colliding: optimistic replay + missing idempotency headers + UX retries. we should treat mobile starter differently from server sampleapps.

leo: proposed immediate remediations:
- change mobile starter to set X-Idempotency-Key per logical operation (UUID)
- make optimistic replay opt-out in the sample (default off)
- add client-side guard to dedupe user taps (debounce the action)
- SDK telemetry: emit tag retry_reason=optimistic_replay or retry_during_429 so we can measure prevalence

tara: +1. also suggest updating default backoff for mobile to be slightly higher since mobile networks create more bursty retries: base=1.8s, multiplier=1.9, max_backoff=14s, jitter=40%, retries=4 for 429. this reduces collision probability when many clients reconnect simultaneously.

amanda: about auto idempotency: mobile apps are typically single-actor per logical op, so auto-generating an idempotency key in the SDK for operations like POSTs might be reasonable as an "opt-in safe mode": config { safe_replay_protection: true }. don't turn it on by default across server SDKs.

leo: agree. sampleapp will enable safe_replay_protection for mobile starters and add a short README section: why idempotency matters for mobile UX, how to check duplicates in logs, and migration steps.

infra-bot: created issue: https://git.redwood/issues/2051 - "mobile starter: safe replay defaults + idempotency" assigned to leo.

docs: i'll add a concise note to devdocs about the single-refresh-promise pattern and a recommended debounce UX snippet for mobile: `disableButtonUntilResponse()` + example code.

tara: i'll open a small patch for the mobile sampleapp to flip optimistic replay off, add header gen snippet, and include a tiny integration test that simulates 429 + rapid user taps. once CI passes we can ship as a minor patch.

leo: thanks. follow-ups: 1) add a lint check to flag example POSTs missing X-Idempotency-Key in mobile starter, 2) emit telemetry for retries that coincided with user action (user_resend=true) so product can see if UX is driving dupes.

amanda: and add a short migration blurb for customers: how to detect duplicates and apply a server-side dedupe key if needed.

tara: good plan. i'll coordinate the MR and the docs patch. :sparkles:
